name: Eastward Ho! Country Club
architects: Herbert Fowler (1922); restorations by Keith Foster (2004, 2007), Kevin Hargrave (2014) and Kyle Franz (2019-2024)

dtm.source: bare earth from the ground points (class 2) of the 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9777, job J1476268), gridded to 1 m in EPSG:32619 by pipeline/intake.py dtm (mean per cell, gaps filled linearly from their rim); NAVD88 m

laz.source: 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9777, job J1476268), flown 4-9 April 2021 (GPS times), leaf-off; vegetation classes 3-5; NAD83(2011) / Massachusetts Mainland (EPSG:6491, m), NAVD88 m; GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, ma2021_cent_east_J1476268.zip, clipped to the world with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

ortho.source: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map ImageServer (USGSNAIPImagery), exported by the developer 2026-10-25 as two JPEGs at 0.5 m in EPSG:32619 (release assorted-lidar-data: 4323.jpg west, 2343.jpg east), placed by their request boxes and mosaicked by pipeline/intake.py ortho; flight year not stated by the service

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 29848550) bbox 1,841 x 1,189 m in UTM 19N + scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 2,048 m east-west (the 2,048 m limit: 103 m of scenery west and east), 1,536 m north-south (173 m south and north)

scorecard_source: GolfPass (golfpass.com/courses/7075-eastward-ho-club), read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat: the current card after Kyle Franz's 2024 restoration (new back tees on 15 and 18), seven tees per hole, men's par 71, rows add up; its back-nine stroke-index row is shifted one cell, read with hole 10 = 16 (matches OpenGolfAPI). Unverified; no club card online. The older card (Stymie, Black 6,437) differs. Rating 70.8/137 (GolfPass, GolfNow). Played from the tips, Championship 6,728 yd (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"); rating GolfPass tee table, Championship 73.3/149 (par 71). The other sets are in scorecard.csv but not built.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar), via NOAA Digital Coast
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-25: standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar). Played from the tips: Championship (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"). Wind 2-12 mph (bays). The lidar (April 2021) predates the 2024 restoration. Bare earth from the lidar's ground points: the release has no DEM. Theme eastward_ho: the course's own, from the developer's photos (developer: a new theme for each course).
red_water_note: Pleasant Bay (w83116684) and Crows Pond (w82282412), mapped as natural=water polygons, and the pond by the 5th (w82421594): red penalty areas wherever they lie, also outside the boundary (standing default; brief: the bay and Crows Pond red)
rough_band_note: a mown band of rough along the fairways, then the restored copper heath (photos eastward.1-5)
